Name: <REQUIRED | string | the dataset's own name, from its paper or README>
DatasetType: <RECOMMENDED | string | raw, derivative or study. Default raw>
HEDVersion: <RECOMMENDED, only if HED tags used | string | HED schema version, e.g. 8.2.0. Delete this key entirely if no *_events.json in the dataset carries a HED field>
License: <RECOMMENDED | string | e.g. CC0. Ask; do not assume>
Authors: <RECOMMENDED | array of string | as the source lists them>
Funding: <OPTIONAL | array of string | grant numbers named by the source>
ReferencesAndLinks: <OPTIONAL | array of string | paper DOI, archive URL>
